final: WITH film_copies AS (SELECT f.film_id, f.rating, COUNT(i.inventory_id) AS copy_count FROM film AS f LEFT JOIN inventory AS i ON i.film_id = f.film_id GROUP BY f.film_id, f.rating), rating_averages AS (SELECT rating, AVG(copy_count) AS rating_avg FROM film_copies GROUP BY rating), compared AS (SELECT fc.film_id, fc.rating, fc.copy_count, fc.copy_count - ra.rating_avg AS rating_difference FROM film_copies AS fc JOIN rating_averages AS ra ON fc.rating = ra.rating), overall AS (SELECT AVG(copy_count) AS overall_avg FROM compared) SELECT c.film_id, c.rating, c.copy_count, c.rating_difference, c.copy_count - o.overall_avg FROM compared AS c JOIN overall AS o ON o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY c.copy_count - o.overall_avg DESC LIMIT 10
